title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：nail　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nail 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the craftsman ① drove the nail that no apprentice in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the driving was the whole of the year. The ② nail, meaning the pin itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a nail, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ nail in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ nail at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A nail, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the craftsman said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the nail was the whole of the matter, meaning the hold and not the pin. The ⑥ nail, meaning the hold and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; nail, he said, is either something you drive or the only word that means both a pin and a hold. He said the hold is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ nail had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ nail of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of recording; nail, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ nail I remember is the pin recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ nail, my mother said in 1983, is the only pin that improves by being recorded; every nail, she said, is a hold that has agreed to look like a pin. She said the hold was the honest half.

answers.why: drive the nail 意为“钉这一枚钉子”，1974 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯记载的一枚钉子做了一遍。
nail 意为“钉子”，指那枚钉子本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
nail 意为“钉子”，指工坊里每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
nail 意为“钉子”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
nail 意为“钉子、维系”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这枚维系就是那件事的全部。
nail 意为“维系”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那枚钉子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
nail 意为“钉子”，指工料簿里写到、被记载的那一枚，到 1979 年这一枚成了工料簿里的一行。
nail 意为“钉子之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的钉子之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记载。
nail 意为“钉子”，我记得的是工料簿里记载过的那一枚，1981 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一枚。
nail 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，钉子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的钉子。
